title: Jia2019: Motor-imagery EEG dataset for stroke patients (Jia 2019)
description: This dataset provides motor-imagery EEG recordings from 15 stroke patients performing cue-based left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery. Data were recorded from 63 EEG channels (10-10 system) at 512 Hz, with 40 trials per class across two runs. It is a BIDS re-release of the original figshare deposit, intended for brain-computer interface research and neurorehabilitation.
methods_description: Cue-based left- vs right-hand motor imagery paradigm in stroke patients, where one hand is paretic and the other unaffected. EEG was recorded from 63 channels at 512 Hz with 50 Hz line frequency, in one session of two runs per subject, 40 trials per class, with trial interval 0-6.8 s. Data are preprocessed and epoched.
